entries.name: Mary Lane

expected.charges: Imprisonment following Greenwood civil-rights organizing; individual statutory charge unverified
expected.sentence: Forty-eight days actually spent at Parchman in 1963. Exact custody endpoints and imposed sentence remain unverified.

updates.charges: Creating a disturbance in a public place during voter-registration work at the Greenwood courthouse
updates.convicted: Found guilty by Judge C. C. Williamson
updates.sentence: Four months in jail and a $200 fine, according to the SNCC chronology of the June 25, 1963 Greenwood arrests. The existing record documents 48 days actually spent at Parchman; the exact release date remains unverified.

entries.rationale: SNCC chronology, printed page 15 (PDF page 15), names Mary Lane in the June 25, 1963 courthouse arrest and conviction group. Refines existing year-only custody start to the already recorded arrest date, adds reported charge and imposed sentence, preserves documented 48 days and year-only release. No release inferred by sentence arithmetic.
